about: The setup steps, in order. The setup skill, bin/setup_record.py (the record and the rendered guide) and the session preload all read this file, so adding a step is an edit here. choices lists the only keys a step may record in core_text/setup.json.

steps.title: This guide
steps.does: Shows every setup step, how long it takes, and which ones can wait.
steps.why: Seeing the whole path first lets you choose what fits the time you have today.
steps.if_skipped: Not skippable, because it is this page and takes a minute.

steps.title: Check the basics
steps.does: Checks that Python and Git are installed, and that the plugin is switched on for this project only.
steps.why: The plugin's own tools run on Python, and Git is how you save your work and undo a mistake.
steps.if_skipped: Not skippable, because without Python the plugin's tools cannot start.

steps.title: An app for your notes
steps.does: Makes sure you can open and edit the notes (Markdown files) this workspace gives you.
steps.why: Your profile, the worklog and every plan are notes, so you need a way to read and change them.
steps.if_skipped: You can still work in chat, but you will not be able to read or edit your own notes.

steps.title: Obsidian (optional)
steps.does: Sets up Obsidian, a free notes app, with a ready-made table of your worklog.
steps.why: Obsidian shows your notes and worklog as one browsable, searchable view instead of a folder of files.
steps.if_skipped: Your notes still open in any editor, just without the Obsidian worklog table.

steps.title: GitHub
steps.does: Connects this computer to a free GitHub account, so your project can be backed up and shared.
steps.why: GitHub keeps a safe copy of your project off this computer and is how most people share code.
steps.if_skipped: Your project lives on this computer only until you connect GitHub, which you can do any time.

steps.title: Your starter workspace
steps.does: Copies the starter files into this project: your profile, the worklog, the rules and the templates.
steps.why: These files are how every agent remembers you and what happened in earlier sessions.
steps.if_skipped: Not skippable, because the rest of setup writes into these files.

steps.title: Research extras (optional)
steps.does: Adds super-novacaelum: current documentation lookup, web research and a cloud browser, on your own accounts.
steps.why: Agents can check today's documentation and the web instead of relying on what they already know.
steps.if_skipped: Agents use built-in web search instead, and anything that needs a real browser comes back to you.

steps.title: About you
steps.does: A short interview, one question at a time, that fills in your profile.
steps.why: Agents read your profile at the start of every session, so they work the way you like from the first message.
steps.if_skipped: Agents fall back to general defaults and will not know your goals or how you like to work.

steps.title: What to try first
steps.does: Three concrete things to try with your new setup.
steps.why: A small first win shows you how the team works before you rely on it for something big.
steps.if_skipped: Nothing breaks, you just start without a suggested first task.
